svg.text: A goal requires a theme, and the user is told so instead
of being shown a form that cannot be submitted.
Creating the life area is BP02.
A goal with no linked idea stays legitimate and is flagged
An archived goal still exists, so its projects are not
There is no in-app undo. Recovery is from version
The flags read the current state. Nothing acts on the
Cascade, the goal alone, or reject. The keep answer is
legal here because an archived goal still exists.
The measures and their history go unasked. Keeping a
Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.
A goal has no parent and no children.
One request frames a theme-only goal and promotes an
idea alike. The horizon may be absent.
Archiving is independent of closing out. A check-out
record already attached stays with the goal.
